home.title: Planning
home.description: The box's strategy: where each discipline is heading and why every WOD exists.
home.loadError: Couldn't load the plans. Try again in a moment.
home.emptyTitle: From one-off WODs to a plan that makes sense
home.emptyBody: A plan has a goal, blocks and weeks. Every WOD knows what it's for and why it exists. It's built around your equipment, your levels, your exercises and your schedule.

choose.title: Choose
choose.body: A template (Open, strength, engine, HYROX…) or tell the AI what you want to achieve.

configure.title: Set up
configure.body: Dates, closures, how you split the 100 points and which tests mark the start and the end.

expect.title: See what to expect
expect.body: An honest projection per test and per capacity, for people who come 2, 3 or 4 days a week.

settings.title: Levels and what athletes see
settings.description: What your box calls each level and how much athletes see of what's coming.

levelHint.foundations: The first few months: less volume and simple variations.

previewHint.none: Athletes only see the WOD once it's published.
previewHint.roles: They see the role of the coming days ("Long engine", "Heavy and short"), not the WOD. Recommended.
previewHint.wod: They see the role of the coming days, and the WOD once it's published.

continuous.name: Continuous programming
continuous.pitch: Balance all year round: rotating blocks and a test every eight weeks.

open.name: Road to the Open
open.pitch: Base, build and peak so you hit the Open at your best.

strength_base.name: Strength base
strength_base.pitch: Eight weeks to push up the basics without losing your engine.

engine.name: Engine
engine.pitch: More aerobic capacity: intervals, long engine work and measured pacing.

muscle_up.name: Muscle-up project
muscle_up.pitch: Pulling strength, ring technique and progressions by level.

back_to_box.name: Back to the box
back_to_box.pitch: September or January: move well again before loading up.

hyrox_race.name: HYROX race
hyrox_race.pitch: Running, stations and race simulations right up to race day.

weightlifting_technique.name: Weightlifting technique
weightlifting_technique.pitch: Snatch and clean & jerk: positions, speed and loads by block.

custom.name: From scratch
custom.pitch: Your blocks, your point split and your tests.

wizard.title: New plan
wizard.description: Six steps. On the right, what you can expect: it updates with every change.
wizard.activeTaken: There's already an active plan in this discipline. Finish or archive it first, or create this one as a draft.
wizard.noSection: There's no discipline with classes you can plan for.
wizard.readOnly: You can see what the box knows, but only whoever programs this discipline can plan it.
wizard.hasActive: This discipline already has an active plan: {name}. The new one will be saved as a draft.

ai.title: Tell the AI what you want to achieve
ai.description: It proposes the whole plan (weeks, blocks, point split and tests) from what it knows about your box. You review it in the next steps.
ai.goalHint: In one or two sentences. No athlete names.
ai.placeholder: Get the people who come 3 days a week to the Open stronger and with a better engine
ai.remaining: {remaining, plural, one {You have # proposal left this week} other {You have # proposals left this week}}
ai.unavailable: AI isn't available at this box. Choose a template.
ai.quota: You've used up this week's proposals. Choose a template or come back on Monday.
ai.failed: The AI couldn't propose the plan. Try again or choose a template.

wizard.templatesHint: Each template comes with its weeks, point split and tests. You can adjust everything afterwards.
wizard.missingEquipment: {count, plural, one {Needs # type of equipment you don't have: it gets swapped out} other {Needs # types of equipment you don't have: they get swapped out}}
wizard.calendarHint: When it starts, how long it lasts and which days the box is closed.
wizard.name: Plan name
wizard.goalHint: What athletes will see in their cycle. Optional.
wizard.eventDateHint: The plan ends the week of the event.
wizard.endsOn: Ends {date} · {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
wizard.closuresHint: Holidays that fall within the plan. Tick the ones you close on: that week is programmed with one day fewer.
wizard.emphasisHint: Split 100 points across the six capacities. The more points, the more it gets trained.
wizard.points: {total} of 100 points · {left, plural, one {# left} other {# left}}
wizard.pointsOver: {total} of 100 points · {over, plural, one {# over} other {# over}}
wizard.emphasisRule: Under 10 points keeps a capacity where it is. It won't improve it.
wizard.testsHint: Up to {max}. Done in the first week and repeated at the end to measure the plan.
wizard.testsWhen: Test week has its own days: maxes first, benchmarks after.
wizard.summaryLine: {from} to {to} · {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} · {blocks, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}
wizard.activateHint: An active plan writes the drafts, and athletes see it in their cycle.
wizard.activateTaken: Can't activate it: {name} is already active. It's saved as a draft.
wizard.expectHint: Rough ranges for people who come at the reference frequency.
wizard.expectEmpty: Choose a template or ask for a proposal to see the projection.

box.title: What your box already knows
box.description: We don't ask what the app already knows. This is where each piece of data comes from.
box.scheduleBody: Classes on {days}, {minutes} min long, up to {size} athletes.
box.scheduleEmpty: This discipline doesn't have a schedule yet: the plan assumes classes Monday to Friday.
box.peopleNoLevels: {athletes} active athletes. No results yet to tell their levels.
box.peopleSource: From bookings and results over the last 8 weeks.
box.frequencyBody: They come {average} days a week on average. The most common combinations:
box.frequencySource: From attendance over the last 8 weeks.
box.equipmentEmpty: No inventory: the plan assumes a standard box's equipment. Add yours in Box equipment.
box.missing: The template needs {kinds} and you don't have it: it's swapped for what you have.
box.libraryBody: {total, plural, one {# exercise in the library} other {# exercises in the library}}: the AI only programs with these.
box.referenceHint: The projection is worked out for people who come this many days a week.

projection.forFrequency: For people who come {days} days a week.
projection.orientative: A guide only. It comes from training rules (emphasis, weeks, frequency and the box's levels) and gets calibrated with your retests.
projection.calibrated: Calibrated with your last cycle (factor {factor}). Still a guide only.

plan.notFound: This plan doesn't exist or isn't in your disciplines.
plan.deleteBody: The plan is deleted. Its WODs stay in the programming, outside the plan.
plan.activeTaken: There's already an active plan in this discipline.

statusDone.finished: Plan finished. Its retest calibrates the next one.

blockFocus.test: Baseline scores: the plan is measured against them.
blockFocus.base: Accumulate: volume on the basics and aerobic engine.
blockFocus.build: Develop: more intensity and more skill.
blockFocus.peak: Realise: less volume, more quality and competition pace.
blockFocus.deload: Deload: less volume to absorb the work done.
blockFocus.maintenance: Maintain: short or holiday weeks without losing what you've gained.

plan.mapHint: Blocks on top; each week with its volume, its intensity and the colour of its days. Tap a week to open it.
plan.emphasisHint: The plan's split and how each block shifts it.
plan.expectHint: From the box's baseline scores, also in kilos and seconds.
plan.testsHint: The median of each athlete's best score before the start.
plan.summary: {workouts, plural, one {# WOD written in the plan} other {# WODs written in the plan}} · {closures, plural, one {# closure day} other {# closure days}}
plan.name: Name

week.notFound: This week isn't part of any plan you can see.
week.published: {count, plural, =0 {No drafts to publish.} one {# WOD published.} other {# WODs published.}}
week.draftsDone: {count, plural, one {# draft written with its role and intent.} other {# drafts written with their role and intent.}}
week.draftsNothing: No class days left without a WOD.
week.copilot: Ask the copilot for a change
week.issues: {count, plural, one {# failed validator check} other {# failed validator checks}}
week.missingTitle: {count, plural, one {# class day still has no WOD} other {# class days still have no WOD}}
week.missingBody: The plan can write each day's skeleton (role, intent, the lift with its progression, engine and accessory work). You, or the AI, write the rest.
week.balanceHint: Minutes programmed per capacity against the block's split.
week.coverageHint: The box's most common day combinations and whether they hit the block's essentials.
week.coverageEmpty: No attendance yet to know which days people combine.
week.limitsHint: What the validator keeps an eye on this week.

limit.heavy_streak: Heavy barbell days in a row

logistics.pool: {block}: {available} machines for {size} athletes. Calories on whichever machine you get.
logistics.short: {block}: needs {needed} stations and there are {available}. It doesn't fit in the class.

week.empty: {classes, plural, =0 {No WOD} one {No WOD · # class} other {No WOD · # classes}}

validation.equipmentOk: Equipment: everything it needs exists and works.
validation.equipmentMissing: Equipment: needs {kinds} and the box doesn't have it.
validation.equipmentNoInventory: Equipment: the box has no inventory. Add it to check this.
validation.logisticsShort: Logistics: block {block} needs {needed} ({kind}) and there are {available}.
validation.logisticsWaves: Logistics: block {block} runs in {waves} heats. Not enough {kind}.
validation.timePartial: Time: {minutes} of {classMinutes} minutes, not counting blocks with no planned minutes.
validation.timeUnknown: Time: no block has planned minutes.
validation.exercisesOk: Exercises: all linked to the library.
validation.exercisesMissing: Exercises: blocks {blocks} don't link any exercise.
validation.patternOk: Patterns: doesn't repeat yesterday's heavy loading.
validation.patternRepeated: Patterns: repeats heavy {patterns} from the day before.
validation.levelsOk: Levels: four versions in the scored blocks.
validation.levelsMissing: Levels: blocks {blocks} are missing a version.
validation.progressionOff: Progression: the plan calls for {movement} at {percent}% this week.

ai.applied: {applied, plural, =0 {Nothing applied} one {# change applied} other {# changes applied}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} other {, # not applied: that day already had a WOD.}}
ai.quota: You've used up this week's proposals. Come back on Monday.
ai.unavailable: AI isn't available at this box.
ai.weekFull: That week already has a WOD on every class day.

failed.not_configured: AI isn't available at this box.
failed.model_error: The AI didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
failed.invalid_output: The proposal didn't pass the validator. Try again.
failed.refused: The AI declined to answer that.
failed.timeout: The AI took too long. Try again.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.description: Ask for a change in plain words. It proposes specific changes and you decide which ones go in.
copilot.messageHint: A day, a week or something that's come up. No athlete names.
copilot.placeholder: We're closed on the afternoon of Thursday the 8th

suggestion.noRowers: We're two rowers down this week
suggestion.lighter: Bring the volume down this week

copilot.neverAlone: Nothing changes until you apply it. New WODs go in as drafts.

aiWeek.title: Week {week} with AI
aiWeek.description: {count, plural, =0 {No days left without a WOD.} one {Writes the class day still without a WOD, within what the plan calls for.} other {Writes the # class days still without a WOD, within what the plan calls for.}}
aiWeek.focusHint: Optional: "people just back from a competition", "exam week". No names.
aiWeek.withPlusHint: A 20 to 40 minute extra per day for Open Box, in line with the class.
aiWeek.remaining: {remaining, plural, one {You have # proposal left this week} other {You have # proposals left this week}}
aiWeek.review: Choose which days go in. Anything you'd already written stays as it is.
aiWeek.asDrafts: They go in as drafts: you review and publish them.

review.title: Sunday review
review.description: Planned versus what happened, and the adjustments for next week.
review.rowsHint: The green band is the plan; the dot is what happened.
review.rowsEmpty: This week has no plan WODs to measure.
review.adjustmentsHint: {count, plural, one {# to decide.} other {# to decide.}} Accepting changes next week's WOD.
review.adjustmentsEmpty: Nothing to adjust: the week went as planned.

adj.cap: From {before} to {after} minutes: WODs of this type run {pct}% longer than planned.
adj.pace: Guided pace ("you should be able to talk"): last week this day hit effort {real} against a target of {target}.
adj.percent: {movement}: repeat {after}% instead of {before}%. Only {completion}% completed the sets.
adj.coverage: {capacity} accessory work for people who come {days}.

review.accepted: Adjustment applied to next week's WOD.
review.learnedHint: Used when writing the coming weeks.
review.learnedEmpty: Not enough results yet to learn anything.

learn.time_run: WODs with running come out {value}% {sign, select, more {longer} less {shorter} other {different}} than planned ({samples} WODs).
learn.time_row: WODs with rowing come out {value}% {sign, select, more {longer} less {shorter} other {different}} than planned ({samples} WODs).
learn.time_other: The rest of the for-time WODs come out {value}% {sign, select, more {longer} less {shorter} other {different}} than planned ({samples} WODs).
learn.effort_long_engine: Long engine work lands {value} effort points {sign, select, more {above} less {below} other {away from}} the target.
learn.attendance_saturday: Saturday turnout is {value}% {sign, select, more {higher} less {lower} other {different}} than the average of the other days.

health.title: Programming health
health.description: Whether the plan is being followed, whether people are improving and coming more, and whether the real balance matches the plan.

kpi.fulfilledNote: WOD duration, effort or sets, against the plan.
kpi.ahead: {count, plural, one {# WOD programmed ahead} other {# WODs programmed ahead}}

health.balanceHint: Plan points against the minutes actually programmed, per capacity.
health.durationsHint: Planned time domains against how long the for-time WODs actually lasted.
health.heatHint: How many days each week hit each pattern. An empty row means it's missing; a hot one means there's too much.
health.heatCell: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in week {week}
health.limitsHint: What the validator keeps an eye on.
health.aiHint: What the plan's AI has cost since it was created.
health.aiEmpty: This plan hasn't used AI yet.
health.aiNote: For {planned, plural, one {# plan WOD} other {# plan WODs}}.

equipment.title: Box equipment
equipment.description: How many units there are of each item and what's under repair. With this, the validator knows whether a WOD fits in the class.
equipment.emptyBody: Start with what limits your classes: rowers, bikes, skis, barbells and kettlebells.
equipment.name: Name
equipment.repairDateHint: Optional. With no date, until you change it.
equipment.invalid: Add a name and a number of units.
equipment.invalidOut: There can't be more units under repair than units in total.
equipment.removeBody: It stops counting for WOD logistics.

strip.outside: This week falls outside the plan.
strip.noPlanBody: With a plan, every day has its role, intent and progression, and the drafts write themselves.

wod.plusHidden: {count, plural, one {Today there's # Class+ block, the Open Box extra. Ask at the box how to add it to your membership.} other {Today there are # Class+ blocks, the Open Box extra. Ask at the box how to add it to your membership.}}

cycle.title: Your cycle
cycle.description: Where the box is heading and where you are.
cycle.noAthlete: Your cycle is for athletes with their own profile at the box.
cycle.noPlanTitle: The box doesn't have a plan running yet
cycle.noPlanBody: Once it does, you'll see which week you're in, your baseline scores and what you can expect here.
cycle.thisWeekHint: The colour is the day's role; the mark is what you've booked or done.
cycle.thisWeekHidden: Your box doesn't show in advance what's on each day.
cycle.testsHint: What you can expect if you come {days} days a week.
cycle.rangeNoBaseline: Do the first-week test to see your range.
cycle.orientative: A guide only: it depends on your consistency, your rest and your starting point.
cycle.constancyHint: {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} in the plan · {perWeek} a week
cycle.constancyEmpty: You haven't come to any plan classes yet.
cycle.levelsHint: One per capacity: you can be RX in strength and Scaled in gymnastics. Mark your version in each WOD.

reason.frequent: Suggested: it's the one you use most

cycle.levelSuggested: Based on your results, we suggest {level}.
cycle.levelExplain: We suggest the highest level you've completed at least twice in the last 60 days. For the first three months, Foundations.

summary.title: Your cycle in numbers
summary.none: There's no cycle to sum up yet.
summary.inProgress: Cycle in progress: the numbers update with every class.
